bio: The beach in Nazaré is famous for its impressive waves, but few know about the rich fishing tradition this charming town harbours. In the restaurant Taberna d’Adélia, whose décor alludes to the marine world through small boats and trawlers, you can taste produce literally brought straight from the sea to the table, and presented to the diner before it is prepared. If you’re lucky enough to find it available, try the oven-roasted redfish, prepared simply yet cooked perfectly, served with a tasty bread stew (açorda). An interesting fact: on the ceiling you’ll find countless “devotions” left by customers, a tradition started back in 1989!...
